name: Stack Overflow for Teams
description: Stack Overflow for Teams (now branded Stack Internal) is a private knowledge management platform, built on the Q&A model of Stack Overflow, that helps organizations capture, validate, and deliver trusted internal knowledge where employees already work.
best_for: Positioned for engineering-driven enterprises seeking to consolidate dispersed organizational knowledge and reduce redundant work; used by companies including Microsoft, Intercom, Expensify, and Box.
features: Private Q&A format with searchable long-form articles
Tags and categories for organizing engineering and company knowledge
Automatic capture and synthesis of knowledge from multiple sources
Trust signals including authorship, recency, usage, and provenance tracking
Slack integration that captures questions and answers and unfurls links inside channels
MCP and API integrations for embedding trusted knowledge into other tools
Subject-matter-expert validation workflows for critical knowledge gaps
Audit logs and role-based access controls for governance
